description: This file defines a final class GetBucketLocationResultMutator that implements a custom mutator for processing the result of a GetBucketLocation request in AWS S3 SDK. It extracts the LocationConstraint from the response body and injects it into the result object.

classes.name: GetBucketLocationResultMutator
classes.description: A mutator class that processes the response of the GetBucketLocation command to extract and set the bucket's location constraint.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Processes the result and response to extract the bucket location, modifying the result accordingly.
